bio.text: Cindy Holscher, a Democrat, is the Democratic candidate for Governor of Kansas in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has represented District 8 in the Kansas Senate since 2021 and served in the Kansas House from 2017 to 2020.
According to her campaign website, she grew up on a farm and she and her husband have lived in Kansas for more than 25 years.
She was born in Slater, Missouri, lives in Overland Park, and earned degrees in journalism, marketing and political science from the University of Missouri in 1992.
